title: Which Element Is Your Soulmate?
description: Discover which of the five classical elements resonates with your spirit!

fire.title: Fire 🔥
fire.description: You're a passionate, dynamic soul who lights up every room you enter. Like fire, you're driven by intensity and emotion. You tackle challenges head-on with boundless energy and inspire others with your enthusiasm. Your warmth draws people close, but remember to balance your blazing spirit with moments of calm.

water.title: Water 💧
water.description: You flow through life with emotional intelligence and adaptability. Like water, you're receptive, intuitive, and deeply empathetic. You have a natural ability to understand others and find creative solutions. Your calm presence brings peace to those around you, and you navigate life's challenges with graceful flexibility.

earth.title: Earth 🌱
earth.description: You're grounded, reliable, and deeply connected to the physical world. Like earth, you value stability, patience, and nurturing others. You have a practical wisdom and a strong sense of responsibility. People turn to you for support and guidance because you remain steady through any storm.

air.title: Air 💨
air.description: You're a free spirit who values intellectual freedom and unconventional thinking. Like air, you bring fresh perspectives and inspire creativity in others. You're social, curious, and always seeking new ideas and experiences. Your versatility allows you to adapt to any situation, though you sometimes struggle with staying grounded.

aether.title: Aether ✨
aether.description: You exist on a different plane—visionary, mystical, and deeply intuitive. Like the fifth element (aether/ether), you have a unique connection to the cosmic and the unknown. You're drawn to spiritual pursuits and have an innate wisdom that others sense but cannot always articulate. Your imagination and creativity know no bounds.
